---
title: "Learning with Data"
---

This freely accessible collection is a starting point for learning with everyday
data. All activities are ungraded. You need no computer or account.

This **journey** groups two courses in a suggested order:

1. [First Steps](courses/first-steps/index.qmd): practice observing data; no prerequisites.
2. [Next Steps](courses/next-steps/index.qmd): practice explaining findings; First Steps is recommended.

The two courses are deliberately small authoring examples. Replace their practice
with distinct learning outcomes and content before publishing a real journey.

This starter has no progress controls. If browser-local tracking is added later,
it will need a clear notice: progress stays in the same browser and profile on
the same device, does not sync, and can be lost when browser data is cleared.
